text: Artisan Miner's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Mining Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point). It is used to purchase Midnight Mining knowledge books and bags full of Midnight ores.

Artisan Skinner's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Skinning Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point). It is used to purchase Midnight Skinning knowledge books and bags full of Midnight skinning crafting reagents.

Artisan Tailor's Moxie is obtained by gaining Midnight Tailoring Knowledge (5 moxie per knowledge point) and completing patron orders that offer it as a reward (30 moxie per order). It is used to purchase Midnight Tailoring recipes and knowledge books.

Ascendant Voidshards drops from most content at a low drop rate, with a higher chance for Ritual Sites at Tier 5 difficulty or higher. It has a 100% drop rate from: *Raid bosses on heroic and mythic difficulties *Mythic+10 and higher *Tier 11 bountiful delves *First 2 Prey nightmare hunts in a week To start collecting the voidshards, the Voidforge and Ascendant Nilhammer must be unlocked. One is given to the player by Decimus after completing The Ascendant Nilhammer.

Ascended nerubians (known in development as evolved nerubians) are an elite type of nerubians found in Azj-Kahet. In return for the nerubians' loyalty, the Harbinger Xal'atath has provided them with knowledge of a dark alchemical process through which they can evolve chosen nerubians into paragons of their race, enhancing their viciousness and turning them into deadly soldiers. Queen Ansurek has eagerly embraced these modifications and offered up her army to achieve Xal'atath's goals, but not all nerubians share Ansurek's enthusiasm for change and have in response begun to plot against her. Ascended are created through the alchemical machinations of toying with the Black Blood of the Old God

The Ashmaul is an ogre group who appear to have made their home in Brute's Rise on Ashran, in . They also control the Ring of Conquest in western Ashran.Hostile to both Alliance and Horde in the region, they are notable for their pyromancers, flamespeakers, and magma casters, summoning fire elementals and hurling flame at enemies.

Aspiring Farseers are Broken shaman located in the Trader's Tier in the Exodar during the draenei heritage questline.
Ashtongue Broken are Broken located in the Refectory in the Black Temple.

Assauged Memories are located in Radiant Echoes zones where the event is currently inactive. *In the Searing Gorge, it appears in the Cauldron as a small fire elemental. *In Dustwallow Marsh, it appears in the Wyrmbog as a sleeping dragon whelp. *In the Dragonblight, it appears on the Path of the Titans as a sleeping dog (possibly :Arfus). When Azeroth's memories resurface in a zone, the corresponding Assauged Memories disappear until the event moves to the next zone. Each Assauged Memories has a timer above it showing which zone is up next.
Ashvane Issued Workboots are found in Ghoststone Diggings on the Siren Isle.
Aspirant Kiipka is a nerubian located in Weaver's Lair in Azj-Kahet. After Anub'okki's demise, Aspirant Kiipka was assigned to the former's duties within the Widow's Lair.
Aspect of the Hydra is a Marksmanship hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Trick Shots.
Aspiring Scoundrel are goblins located in Hovel Hill in Undermine.

While a Player vs. Player-focused zone, Ashran is home to a surprising number of quests - though a large number of those quests have since been removed. Patch 8.0.1 have discontinued Ashran, and removed almost all quests associated with it. As of patch 8.2.0 most of those quests are now done on the Battleground version of Ashran.

Aspectral Emissary's Primal Robes are part of the Jewels of the Aspectral Emissary, the tier 33 Liberation of Undermine set for mages. They can be obtained in a few different ways: *Using a Mystic Greased Gallybux, which drops from Sprocketmonger Lockenstock in the Liberation of Undermine raid *Kari Bridgeblaster in the Undermine for 1 Excessively Bejeweled Curio *Converting another The War Within Season 2 chestpiece using the Catalyst

Ashmaul Strongbox is rewarded for subsequent wins to Alliance players by killing High Warlord Volrath and Horde players by killing Grand Marshal Tremblade in the Ashran battleground. For the first win of the day, see Gleaming Ashmaul Strongbox instead.

Ashvane Co. Survey Report is looted from Dat-Dat's Book Stash. To unlock the chest, the player first must kill First Mate Dat-Dat, who drops First Mate Dat-Dat's Key. Both Dat-Dat and his Book Stash are located on the middle ship of the coast of Stormtide Dregs on Siren Isle. The chest can be found on the lowest "entry level" section of the ship, beside the forward mast and in front of a blocked-off door.

Ashwood Lumber is a type of lumber gathered in zones, including Mount Hyjal, the Twilight Highlands, Uldum, and the Ruins of Gilneas. It is used to craft housing decor with Cataclysm proficiency professions. Collecting 250 Ashwood Lumber will grant the Cataclysmic Lumberjack achievement.
